snippet.title: VR Sneaking Mission 2 TRAILER (Steath infiltration action game Android)
snippet.description:
The new Game infiltration by David Amado Fernandez for Android.
Infiltration, Sneaking and action you find in this new app, the secuel of    Vr tactic mission, now with better graphics, better control and animation, more actions, weapons and item to use in your mission.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.DavidAmado.VrSneakingMission2
